description.en:
ProEdition copies of the base-game Ropa Tiger 6S self-propelled beet harvester, its RR-XL 9x45 header and the header trailer.
The models, textures, sounds and settings are the same as the base-game machines. They are listed in the shop next to the originals: - Beet Harvesters: "Tiger 6S ProEdition" - Beet Harvester Headers: "RR-XL 9x45 ProEdition" and the "ProEdition" header trailer
ProEdition: the header harvests, and the Tiger holds, every root crop and vegetable in the base game, plus sugar cane: sugar beet, beetroot, potatoes, carrots, parsnips, green beans, peas, spinach, onions and sugar cane (topped and cut, with the game's cane cutting effects and cane on the belts).
Tiger shop options: three tanks (Normal 43 m³, Boosted 57.5 m³, Extreme 63 m³), the 996 hp Tiger ProEdition engine, a cab window tint (Light, Medium or Dark), the side logo and rear logo each on or off, and three colors: a main color theme, a mechanical parts color for the belts and the cleaning section, and a rim color. Header and header trailer: the same main color theme and black color group (#1) as the Tiger, so all three machines can be themed to match; the trailer also has a rim color for its rims and hubs.
Multiplayer: every player needs the mod.
